==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|temporary|-ly<id:adverbial>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌtɛmpəˈɹɛɹəli/|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɛmp(ə)r(ər)ɪli/|/ˌtɛmp(ə)ˈrɛrɪli/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-temporarily.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Adverb===
{{en-adv|-}}

# For a [[limited]] [[period]] of [[time]]; not [[permanently]].
#* {{quote-journal
|en
|date=1975-04-13
|title=Late President funeral service set for April 16
|journal=Free China Weekly
|url=https://archive.org/details/sim_free-china-weekly_1975-04-13_16_14/
|volume=XVI
|issue=14
|issn=0016-0318
|oclc=1786626
|page=1
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/sim_free-china-weekly_1975-04-13_16_14/
|column=1
|text=The committee also decided that the remains of President Chiang will be entombed '''temporarily''' by Tzu Lake, at Tahsi township of Taoyuan County in northern Taiwan, and will be buried on the mainland after it is recovered.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Daniel Dale|title=New York Post temporarily deletes, then edits false story that claimed Harris’ book was given out in migrant ‘welcome kits’|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/27/politics/new-york-post-fact-check-kamala-harris-book-migrants/index.html|date=2021-04-27|passage=The New York Post also '''temporarily''' took down and then revised and republished an article about the Fox reporter’s exchange with White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki on Monday.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260808030658/https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/27/politics/new-york-post-fact-check-kamala-harris-book-migrants/index.html|archivedate=8 August 2026}}

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|ephemerally}}, {{l|en|fleetingly}}, {{l|en|transiently}}; see also [[Thesaurus:temporarily]]
